title: CLI tool honours argv and its documented exit codes
intent: Exit codes are a contract, not a side effect. A runtime that runs code but loses the exit code cannot host CI tooling, so this fixture asserts both success and a deliberate failure path.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Command line (CLI) (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Invocation that must fail with the documented usage code

knownLimits: A CLI that prints the right output but exits 0 on bad input fails this fixture; that is the point of the second step.
